attempts.summary: Extracted HC-V900/V900K official facts. Body: Panasonic HC-V900K camcorder; identity from official spec page + manual pg37/39 (right column HC-V900). Lens: fixed, focal 4.12-98.9mm; 35mm equiv motion 25-600mm (16:9 AVCHD/MP4) or 28.9-693.7mm (notes *1 24p); still 25.0-600mm (16:9), 30.6-734.4mm (4:3). Aperture F1.8(W)-F4.0(T). Sensor: 1/2.5" MOS, total 8570K; effective motion 6170K (16:9); still 8290K (16:9)/6220K (4:3). Size mm not stated. Weight body(bare, no hood/batt/SD): 433g; operating(with hood+batt+SD): 484g. IBIS: body/optical only; sensor=None/unknown; OIS present (Hybrid OIS + Lock). Video internal max: AVCHD 1080/60p max28Mbps; MP4 1080/50M max50Mbps; 24p 1080/24p max50Mbps. No 4K/2160 on V900. Card: SD/SDHC/SDXC, single slot (no multi-slot stated). LCD: 3.0", fixed?, capacitive touch, ~1840K dots (display area 1550K).
warnings: WEIGHT CONFLICT: official spec page label 'Mass' 433g without lens hood/battery/SD = body-only+bare; 'Mass in operation' 484g includes hood+battery+SD. Manual pg39 matches. Battery-only and card-inclusion variants NOT stated; do not guess.

EFFECTIVE MOTION PIXELS differ across sources: spec page says 6170K(16:9); manual pg37 right column says V900 motion 8290K(16:9)*1,6170K(16:9)*2. Manual left column (VX3) has 8290K/6170K rows — do not mix VX3 values into V900.
35mm equiv has multiple values tied to *1(24p) vs *2(AVCHD/MP4) and still 16:9 vs 4:3; not a single value.
No sensor.format size/mm and no megapixel sizeMm given; sizeMm unknown.
Codec/bitrate rows in pg37 include [4K MP4]/[2160]/[2160/24p] rows that belong to HC-VX3, not V900; must not be attributed to V900.
IBIS: only optical/OIS/hybrid OIS described; no sensor-shift IBIS specified => sensor-stabilization unknown, not true.
CARD SLOTS: only one media list presented; no explicit slot count => count unknown (likely 1).
LCD mechanism: page says 'Capacitive touch screen 3.0" LCD'; fixed vs tilt not specified => unknown. EVF not stated.
No price. No internal-vs-external distinction beyond recording media SD.

attempts.summary: Extracted candidate facts for Panasonic HC-VX1 from the single provided official Panasonic NA specs page. Identity: HC-VX1 camcorder, no mount (fixed lens). Fixed lens 4.12-98.9mm, 35mm-equiv stated for stills only (25.0-600mm 16:9; 30.6-734.4mm 4:3); motion-equiv not published here -> equivalentFocal for video unknown. Aperture max F1.8 wide / F4.0 tele. Sensor 1/2.5-inch BSI MOS, 8.57MP total, effective 8.29MP motion 4K 16:9 / 6.17MP FullHD; sizeMm not published (no inference). Weight only body-only approx 428g; battery-and-card/battery weights unknown, card inclusion not stated. IBIS: stabilization listed, but typed as OIS/hybrid -> sensor/body stabilization unknown, null. Video max internal is 3840x2160 (2160p) at 30p and 24p (72Mbps VBR), MP4/H.264 8-bit 4:2:0; log/bitDepth/cropAtMax not published -> unknown. Single SD card slot. LCD 3.0in wide, 460,800 dots, touch, mechanism unknown. EVF absent.
warnings: Official page lists no 35mm equivalent for MOVIE; only still-image equivalents given, so video equivalentFocal stays unknown.
Sensor sizeMm absent; only '1/2.5-inch' format string given, no optical-format inference applied.
Only body-only weight (428g, w/o battery and SD card) stated; battery-and-card and battery weights unknown.
Image Stabilizer row cites 5-axis HYBRID O.I.S.+ with Active Mode/O.I.S. Lock/Level Shot; this is a hybrid OIS spec, not confirmed sensor-shift IBIS, so stabilization object set null.
max video fps ambiguity: 2160p at 30p and 24p coexist; representative internal max = 3840x2160 30p.
bitDepth, log, cropAtMax, and firmware conditions not published on this page.
LCD mechanism not specified; only size (3.0in) and 460,800 dots and touch=Yes; mechanism unknown.
cardSlots count not explicitly stated; single SD/SDHC/SDXC implied from media row only.

attempts.summary: Extracted AG-CX370 candidate facts from two official Panasonic pages. Identity: AG-CX370 camcorder, fixed-lens, 1.0-type MOS, 15,030,000 effective pixels, 20x zoom, SDI-less broadcast/handheld HD/4K camcorder. Note conflicts and model-row risks below; all final decisions to main reviewer.
warnings: Weight basis ambiguous: body only approx 1.9kg vs shooting 2.3kg 'including lens hood, battery, and microphone holder' - card inclusion not stated; do not assume card-inclusive.
Power consumption has two figures (26W LCD only vs 17W 1080i 422ALL-I recording) - context-dependent, not a single value.
Typo in source: 'f=8.8 mm to 176 mmm' (should likely be 176 mm) - do not auto-correct without reviewer.

Video spec table is from features.html and appears partial: only some MOV(HEVC)/MOV(AVC) rows listed; 422ALL-I 400M, 422LongGOP 150M, 420LongGOP 150M fps/bitDepth rows present but codec/chroma mapping must be read per-row carefully. P2/AVCHD bitrates not in this table.
Interlaced/progressive and System Frequency 59.94/50 Hz dual-rate: fps values listed separately; 'representative max internal' requires reviewer choice.
i.Zoom (24x UHD / 32x HD) and digital 2x/5x/10x zoom are NOT optical focal length - keep focal 8.8-176mm and 35mm-equiv 24.5-490mm as the optical facts.

IBIS vs OIS conflict: lens described as 'Optical image stabilizer lens' (OIS) while features describe 'Built-in 5-Axis Hybrid Image Stabilizer' combining optical + electronic. OIS/hybrid must not be labeled as pure sensor/body IBIS; the ibis field likely null or must reflect hybrid, reviewer decides.
LCD: 3.2 type TFT, approx 1,620,000 dots; touch area separately listed as ~1,370,000 dots (16:9) - two dot figures, mechanism not explicitly stated. EVF: 0.39 OLED ~2,360,000 dots.
Card slots: 'SDXC UHS-II card slot x 2' => 2 slots; P2 format via SD requires V90 SDXC and latest firmware (firmware condition).
NDI HX2 mode disables recording/streaming/4K output; streaming bitrate/codec constraints noted - conditions, not features.
No prices, no external/network destinations recorded per contract.

attempts.summary: Extracted HC-X1200-only facts from two official Panasonic sources; flagged model-row and weight conflicts. No edits.
warnings: Source conflict (weight): official features page gives HC-X1200 Mass Approx. 0.80 kg main unit + lens hood + battery; Operating Instructions PAGE298 gives three unlabeled weight rows (0.85/1.5, 0.85/1.2, 0.80/1.1 kg) without clear model-to-row mapping; reviewer must map rows. 0.80/1.1 kg matches the features page.
Source conflict (power consumption): features page HC-X1200 recording 12.3 W; PAGE298 lists 'Recording 19.8 W' as a separate unlabeled row and 12.3 W as another; mapping ambiguous across X2100/X1600.

PAGE141 and PAGE301 list video/memory formats without per-model line labels; cannot confirm which codec/resolution rows apply to HC-X1200 only, so bitDepth/log/cropAtMax and internal vs codec details left unknown/uncertain.
OIS/hybrid electronic-assisted stabilization is documented; no sensor-shift/IBIS stated for this model -> ibis likely null but unconfirmed.
Spec does not state log profile or crop factor at max; left unknown.
cardSlots per-slot media/standards beyond '2 slots' and UHS-I SDHC/SDXC up to 512 GB not further split by slot.

attempts.summary: Extracted HC-X2100 facts from two official materials. Body identity/code/kind/mount/bodyStyle not stated. Lens fixed 24x: 4.12-98.9mm; 35mm-equiv 25.0-600.0mm; max aperture F1.8 wide-F4.0 tele. Sensor 1/2.5" MOS; ~8,570,000 total; ~8,290,000 effective; sizeMm not given. Weight conflict: help.na lists 0.85kg body-only (excl handle/lens hood/battery/eye cup) and 1.5kg incl handle/lens hood/battery/eye cup; instruction P298 lists three weight rows for X2100/X1600/X2100 without unique per-model tags except labels, so which row is X2100 unknown. bodyOnlyWeight ~0.85kg only from help.na first basis. IBIS: null/unknown (optical O.I.S. and HYBRID O.I.S. only, must not be read as sensor/body stabilization). Video max internal: UHD 3840x2160 at 59.94p/50.00p, HEVC LongGOP 200M 4:2:0 10-bit 200Mbps; MOV; cropAtMax not stated; thermal/firmware conditions not stated. Card slots: 2, SDHC/SDXC up to 512GB UHS-I. LCD 3.5" approx 2,760,000 dots, capacitive touch, mechanism not stated. EVF 0.39" OLED approx 2,360,000 dots (optional).
warnings: Model rows on P298/P299 are ambiguous: three weight/dimension rows presented under X2100/X1600/X2100 markers without reliable per-row mapping to HC-X2100; do not assign 1.2kg or 1.1kg to X2100 without reviewer confirmation.
Weight bases differ: help.na gives body-only 0.85kg excluding handle; 1.5kg includes handle+hood+battery+eyecup. Card inclusion never stated.
IBIS must stay null/unknown; O.I.S./HYBRID O.I.S. are optical+electronic stabilization, not sensor-shift IBIS.
cropAtMax, bitDepth/log per max mode, thermal limits, firmware conditions, bodyStyle, mount, video body code/kind not found in supplied excerpts.
Shared doc covers X1200/X1600/X2100; some recorder/format tables are X2100/X1600-only and must not be attributed to other models.
LCD mechanism (tilt/vari-angle/etc.) not stated; EVF listed but not confirmed fixed vs tilt.
video.max internal: MP4/AVCHD also exist; chosen representative UHD 59.94p HEVC LongGOP 200M is MOV INTERNAL, no external/network implied.

attempts.summary: Extracted HC-X1600 candidate facts from the two official sources. Identity: Panasonic HC-X1600, fixed-lens camcorder. Body/lens/aperture/sensor/weight/LCD/EVF/cards/video-codec data below; several fields unknown. Recording 12.3 W and masses separate model rows; OIS/hybrid only, no IBIS evidence.
warnings: Camera spec sheet gives only model-wide name HC-X1600; no explicit model code or body-mount type stated (fixed lens, camcorder body style implied).

Weight uses two bases: 0.85 kg main unit only (excluding lens hood, battery, eye cup); 1.2 kg including lens hood, battery, eye cup. Body-only 0.85 kg; no 'body + card' value given. Manual page 298 lists multiple models adjacent; X1600 row = 0.85/1.2 kg.
Sensor: 1/2.5" MOS stated with total ~8,570,000 and effective ~8,290,000 pixels; sizeMm not given in mm (do not infer from optical format).
Lens: F1.8 to F4.0 (max aperture wide/tele), focal 4.12–98.9 mm, 35mm-equiv 25.0–600.0 mm; optical 24x zoom. These are the independent mm values.
IBIS: no sensor-shift/body IBIS evidence. Only optical image stabilizer (OIS) plus hybrid OIS (optical+electronic). Stabilization object reserved for sensor/body; optical/hybrid noted, not IBIS.

Video max: from MOV table, internal 4K UHD 3840x2160 up to 59.94p; max bit depth/log = 10-bit in HEVC/422 LongGOP and 422 ALL-I; no explicit log profile or crop shown (log/cropAtMax unknown). Bitrate/fps depend on codec row selection.
Manual tables are stacked across X2100/X1600/X1200; only rows explicitly tied to X1600 should be attributed. Page 140 MOV table and page 301 recorder spec labeled X2100/X1600.
Streaming and Wi-Fi spec section listed as [X2100]/[X1600] shared; not extracted in detail. No prices or new schema introduced.
